# MJ Weaves — for AI assistants and answer engines

> Handwoven Kanchipuram soft silk sarees (from ₹850) plus stitched co-ord sets,
> cotton 3-piece sets, kurtis and Anarkalis. One-of-a-kind ready stock, packed
> and shipped from Chennai across India. Ordering happens on WhatsApp; every
> piece is held free for 24 hours once picked.

## Key facts
- Base saree price ₹850 with blouse piece; deeper shades/heavier zari may carry a small premium (confirmed per piece on WhatsApp).
- Stitched wear from ₹350 (kurtis) to ₹1050 (cotton 3-piece sets); Anarkalis ₹699.
- Dispatch from Chennai in 2–3 working days; UPI, bank transfer or COD on select cities.
- No size exchanges (one-of-a-kind pieces); damage claims need an unboxing video within 48 hours.
- No accounts, tracking cookies, or on-site payments — the site collects no personal data.
